newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle trade thin $110/dressed - trade.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle trade thin $110/dressed - trade.

text.p: Nebraska feedlot cattle sold at $110.00 per cwt on a dressed basis in light volume, down $1.00 from last week's extreme top, but steady with the bulk of last week's sales, market sources said.
About 1,500 head sold at $110.00 as of midday with an additional 500 selling at $68.00 per cwt on a live basis in western Nebraska, the sources said.
The sales on a live basis were down $1.00 from last week's top and down $0.50 from the bulk of sales, they said.
Packers reportedly were showing increased buying interest as the day progressed, sources said.
